_info: Stock (standard) configuration of ONE engine, loaded automatically when this engine is selected and by the button 'Load stock configuration'. File name = engine id. 'chargers': a catalog id (string) or {"profile": {...}, "count": n} for a part that belongs to this engine only. Maps use the shared rpm axis [800,2000,3500,5000,6000,7000] and load axis [0,25,50,75,100] ([loadIdx][rpmIdx]). 'reference' holds a known factory power figure for later calibration.
name: Porsche 997 Carrera 3.6 Flat-Six (325 PS) - stock configuration
generated: ignition and fuel maps derived from the shared base maps: rpm axis stretched to this engine's redline, fuel scaled by displacement per cylinder, ignition for a naturally aspirated engine (low-load row, 0.1 deg retard per % load)

reference.standard: Rating in PS/kW as published, converted to mechanical hp with 1 hp = 1.01387 PS
reference.market: Europe/North America (as stated in the source)
reference.source: Porsche Newsroom '60 Years Porsche 911 - 6th generation engines' (3.6-litre flat-six, 325 PS); fcpeuro.com 997 engine guide (325 hp at 6800 rpm, 3.8 has 3 mm larger bore than the 3.6); stuttcars.com (325 SAE hp, 273 lbf·ft/370 N·m, 7200 rpm redline on the Carrera S)
reference.notes: Estimated, not in the sources: connecting rod length (136.6 mm = 1.65 x stroke); rev limiter 7500 rpm (+300 over the published redline/maximum speed); oil mass 6.5 kg (scaled from displacement); firing order (typical for this layout, not confirmed in the sources); stroke 82.8 mm and compression ratio (published values recalled, not re-confirmed in this search). Stock fuel 'super-plus-98' is the lowest octane rating without knock in this simulation; it can differ from the real fuel requirement.
